record.dic_text:
08060 Shammay {sham-mah'-ee}

源自 08073; 陽性專有名詞 人名

AV - Shammai 6; 6

沙買 = "荒涼的"
1) 猶大人阿南的兒子, 耶拉篾的子孫 (#代上 2:28|)
2) 猶大人利肯的兒子, 瑪雲的父親, 他是耶拉蔑的兄弟迦勒的後裔
   (#代上 2:42-45|)
3) 猶大人米列之子, 米利暗和以實提摩的兄弟 (#代上 4:17|)
record.edic_text:
08060 Shammay {sham-mah'-ee}

from 08073;; n pr m

AV - Shammai 6; 6

Shammai = "desolate"
1) a Judaite, son of Onam and descendant of Jerahmeel
2) a Judaite, son of Rekem, father of Maon, and descendant of
   Jerahmeel's brother, Caleb
3) a Judaite, son of Mered and brother of Miriam and Ishbah
